Processing_Method: Download Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8/9 imagery for study area. Compute cloud-free annual NDVI composite for each year 2015–current using median pixel composite. Store as multi-band raster (one band per year) or separate annual GeoTIFFs. Apply water and cloud masks. Normalise: NDVI = (NIR−Red)/(NIR+Red); values −1 to +1.
Key_QC_Rules: Minimum 3 cloud-free scenes per year required per tile; flag tiles with fewer scenes — lower data confidence. Water bodies (G15 class 80) must be masked. Annual composites should show expected seasonal pattern (wet season NDVI peak). Cross-check with G15 land cover classes: built-up (class 50) should have lower NDVI than tree cover (class 10).

Processing_Method: For each pixel: compute linear regression slope (NDVI units/year) across all available annual G47 composites (minimum 8 years for trend). Report: slope; p-value; R-squared. Positive slope = greening; negative slope = browning/degradation. Express as % change per year relative to 2015 baseline mean. Mask non-vegetated pixels (NDVI < 0.1 in baseline year).
Key_QC_Rules: Minimum 8 annual observations required for trend computation; mask pixels with fewer. P-value < 0.10 required before labelling as significant trend. Cross-validate with DB03 erosion sites: high-severity active sites should show negative NDVI trend. Cross-validate with G53 forest loss: deforested pixels should show strongly negative trend.

Processing_Method: Compute Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation: A = R × K × LS × C × P where A = annual soil loss (t/ha/yr). R-factor: from G22 rainfall erosivity (EI30 index computed from CHIRPS). K-factor: from ISRIC SoilGrids soil erodibility (download and clip to study area). LS-factor: computed from G09 DEM and G10 slope. C-factor: from G15 land cover classification using literature values. P-factor: from field observations or assumed = 1 where no conservation practice data available. Document all factor values and sources in RUSLE_METHODOLOGY.md.
Key_QC_Rules: All five RUSLE factors must be documented with source before model runs. K-factor must be clipped to study area from ISRIC. C-factor lookup table must be approved before computation — stored in LKP_RUSLE_C_Factors.csv. P-factor default = 1 where unknown — document this assumption. Output range: 0 to >200 t/ha/yr; values > 200 are extreme and must be field-verified.

Processing_Method: Normalise G48 NDVI trend (adverse direction = negative values mapped to 0–100) and G49 RUSLE soil loss (log-transformed then min-max normalised 0–100). Add land cover change penalty where G15 current epoch shows conversion from natural vegetation. Weights: NDVI trend 40% + RUSLE 40% + LC change 20%. Aggregate to community-level polygon for risk index integration.
Key_QC_Rules: Pre-specify weights before computation (HAZARD_MODEL_DECISIONS.csv — add HMD07). Sensitivity test with equal weights. Cross-check spatial pattern: communities near G26 high-severity erosion sites should score higher on G50. Land cover change detection requires two WorldCover epochs — note if only one epoch available at implementation (use NDVI trend as proxy).
